_why: Registers whose own content reaches into the band the renderer reserves for the burned caption, or past the action-safe border. Some are legitimately FULL-BLEED — a generative field's ground IS the frame, and a caption sits on that ground the way it sits on any other. TYPE is different: a title in the band is two pieces of copy drawn on top of each other, which is why `text` is measured separately and why any value at all counts. The fraction cannot see it: CardStack3D set its title wholly inside the band and measured 2.1%, under the threshold, while AuroraFlow's legitimate field measured 53%. Swept that way, 32 of 152 registers were placing copy in the band and none of them was in this file. Measured by scripts/band_debt.py --write on a standalone still of each register at its demo defaults, at the frame useT() calls SETTLED.
_measured_against: band/edge = ink FRACTIONS (thresholds shot_still_qa CAPTION_FRAC_ERR / EDGE_FRAC_ERR); band = captionBand(W,H) at 1920x1080 = 227px. `text` = px of the register's own TYPE reaching into that band, asked of the DOM (runtime/textSafe.tsx) — ANY value is debt. Rendered under dna=product, the themed path every delivered film uses.
_measured_at: the frame useT() calls SETTLED (REDUCED_MOTION_T), derived per register from its own exported DURATION — the frame every visual gate reads
